intros.inverness: The northern lights are rare this far south, so these are the day trips Inverness is known for.
intros.namibrand: Viator lists no stargazing tours for NamibRand itself. These are desert trips to nearby Sossusvlei, so ask the operator where you sleep and how dark it is there.
